items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I played with Frankie Newton and his band. We played all over in...in the country over there

ctx.x: Who else would be in there, playing...or singing?

Frankie Newton's band used to play at the after-hours that I like to go there because I knowed him, and a fellow called me up the other day on the phone. Just called me up two days ago from New York City...I cain't think of his name..."Hucklebuck" used to play...made a number called "Hucklebuck"...mmmmmmnnnnh...what the devil is his name? I couldn't think of it when I was talkin' to him. I had to ask him his name. He told me his name anyway, and I didn't remember. I just... I can't remember no more. My thoughts…
You've been remembering a lot of things here today.
